profile.name: Arduino模数采集器
profile.description: 基于Arduino的模数采集装置，通过网络连接读取模拟电压并转换为数字信号，适合实验中采集传感器、电压输出等低速模拟量数据。
profile.description_en: An Arduino-based analog-to-digital acquisition device that reads analog voltages over a network connection and converts them into digital values. It is suitable for laboratory acquisition of low-speed analog signals such as sensor outputs and general voltage measurements.
